title: How to Survive a Riot
lines: If a crowd turns into a riot, | the biggest danger often isn't the violence. | It's the crowd itself.
Step one: leave early. | The moment it {turns,/~turns,} walk away. Don't stop to film.
Stay at the edges. | Avoid walls, fences and narrow streets: that's where people get crushed.
If the crowd surges, | don't fight it. | Go with it, and drift sideways between waves.
Arms up, like a boxer. | Protect your chest, so you can keep breathing.
If you fall, get up fast. | If you can't, curl up on your side and cover your head.
Tear gas? | Move upwind and uphill. | Don't rub your eyes: flush them with water.
Once you're out, get indoors, | away from windows.
Have you ever been in a crowd that turned? | Tell me in the comments.
